sellEthForTokenToUniswapV3(bytes,uint256.details: Sell attached ETH directly against uniswap v3.

params.encodedPath: Uniswap-encoded path, where the first token is WETH.
params.minBuyAmount: Minimum amount of the last token in the path to buy.
params.recipient: The recipient of the bought tokens. Can be zero for sender.

returns.buyAmount: Amount of the last token in the path bought.

sellTokenForEthToUniswapV3(bytes,uint256.details: Sell a token for ETH directly against uniswap v3.

params.encodedPath: Uniswap-encoded path, where the last token is WETH.
params.minBuyAmount: Minimum amount of ETH to buy.
params.recipient: The recipient of the bought tokens. Can be zero for sender.
params.sellAmount: amount of the first token in the path to sell.

sellTokenForTokenToUniswapV3(bytes,uint2.details: Sell a token for another token directly against uniswap v3.

params.minBuyAmount: Minimum amount of the last token in the path to buy.
params.recipient: The recipient of the bought tokens. Can be zero for sender.
params.sellAmount: amount of the first token in the path to sell.

returns.buyAmount: Amount of the last token in the path bought.

uniswapV3SwapCallback(int256,int256,byte.details: The UniswapV3 pool swap callback which pays the funds requested      by the caller/pool to the pool. Can only be called by a valid      UniswapV3 pool.

params.data: Arbitrary data forwarded from swap() caller. An ABI-encoded        struct of: inputToken, outputToken, fee, payer

PATH_SKIP_HOP_SIZE.details: How many bytes to skip ahead in an encoded path to start at the next hop:      sizeof(address(inputToken) | uint24(fee))

SINGLE_HOP_PATH_SIZE.details: Minimum size of an encoded swap path:      sizeof(address(inputToken) | uint24(fee) | address(outputToken))

SWAP_CALLBACK_DATA_SIZE.details: The size of the swap callback data.

UNI_FF_FACTORY_ADDRESS.details: UniswapV3 Factory contract address prepended with '0xff' and left-aligned.

params.minBuyAmount: Minimum amount of the last token in the path to buy.
params.recipient: The recipient of the bought tokens. Can be zero for sender.

returns.buyAmount: Amount of the last token in the path bought.

swap(address,bool,int256,uint160,bytes).details: The caller of this method receives a callback in the form of IUniswapV3SwapCallback#uniswapV3SwapCallback

params.amountSpecified: The amount of the swap, which implicitly configures the swap as exact input (positive), or exact output (negative)
params.data: Any data to be passed through to the callback
params.recipient: The address to receive the output of the swap
params.sqrtPriceLimitX96: The Q64.96 sqrt price limit. If zero for one, the price cannot be less than this value after the swap. If one for zero, the price cannot be greater than this value after the swap
params.zeroForOne: The direction of the swap, true for token0 to token1, false for token1 to token0

returns.amount0: The delta of the balance of token0 of the pool, exact when negative, minimum when positive
returns.amount1: The delta of the balance of token1 of the pool, exact when negative, minimum when positive
